agent_rules.retail: Finite panic-sensitive exit wave; excess sell demand waits for next step.
agent_rules.whale: Finite cohort requests 1:1 fiat redemption and waits in FIFO queue.
agent_rules.arbitrageur: Finite USD capital weighted by cohort share; positive net profit after pool fee and gas required; acquired USDC queues for redemption; capital returns only on settlement.
agent_rules.issuer: Hypothetical cash buffer and delayed liquid reserve settlement; FIFO hourly capacity; weekend UTC banking closure blocks settlement. No actual issuer reserves inferred.
agent_rules.yield_chaser: Finite additional holder inventory outside the initial exit wave; compare max(DeFi APY, token APY) with T-bill APY net of holding-period switching cost; issuer FIFO redemption, not DEX price arbitrage.
agent_rules.strategic_lp: Remove all three pool reserves proportionally under quote-deviation/volatility risk, bounded by configured total withdrawal fraction; no LP deposits modeled.
agent_rules.macro: Treasury proxy mode only: duration loss approximation D × positive rate change × Treasury exposure; credit impairment under forced or seeded hazard scenario; frozen reserves return after delay. User rating multipliers are illustrative and uncalibrated.
agent_rules.recovery: First hour after deepest discount within 1% of $1 for six consecutive samples; null means not recovered within horizon. $1 is an assumed future redemption anchor, not a forecast.

limitations: Single-event in-sample reference fit, not structural identification or out-of-event validation. Hourly observations may miss the intraday low. Global redemption pressure is an assumed-supply percentage, not percent of pool TVL.
